title: Demonstrate accounting in a perpetual inventory system

items.concept: Initial recognition of inventory under perpetual gross method; freight-in; discount taken; AP settlement; sale (COGS); subsequent inventory rollforward; period-end physical-count adjusting JE (emphasis)
Number-variant twin—perpetual gross method purchase cycle, sale, inventory schedule, period-end shortage adjusting JE
Perpetual net method initial recognition; payment within terms; settlement after discount period (Interest Expense); sale; period-end overage adjusting JE; subsequent inventory schedule
Classification of purchase-discount outcomes under perpetual gross vs net methods
Period-end adjusting JE when perpetual books exceed physical count
